signal.title: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
signal.summary: Microsoft introduced the Copilot harness in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service as a public preview on October 28, 2026. Teams can configure agents using reusable skills, connected tools and MCP integrations while Foundry runs the agent loop and sandbox. The preview differs from the generally available long-running resilience feature for hosted agents, and the harness has its own regional, model and billing constraints.
